# Pinned QR encoder

`qrcode-generator-1.4.4.js` is the unmodified JavaScript QR encoder from npm package `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`, by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT license is included alongside it.

- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/1.4.4
- Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- License source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/master/LICENSE
- Retrieved: 2026-09-26. npm tarball integrity was verified before extracting the encoder.
- JavaScript SHA-256: `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`

The encoder runs locally. Invitation URLs are never sent to a QR generation service. Updating it requires checking the license/integrity and repeating QR decoding and browser checks. Git preserves upstream bytes rather than converting line endings.
